$comment: A test world for recordings (docs/THEATER_MODE.md §6.3; owner, 2026-11-14: "Do a rendered recording of a 10 block high dam of a river suddenly deleted … if you need tools to generate a valley with a river/lake with a dam, go ahead and make them"). Built on the flat world (?world=flat) by dwell-sim scene.rs (validated there; `cargo test -p dwell-sim scene` checks every file here): a valley 320 m long down +z from (0, 0), its floor 14 m wide and 12 m under the land at its head, falling 1 m per 100 m, its sides and ends rising 1 in 2 (½ m ramps) to the land; a stone dam of ten 1 m blocks across it 100 m down, 4 m thick, a lake behind it one metre under its top (9 m deep at the dam), held still from the start; the water at real time; at 3 s the dam is deleted all at once. Prototype content: the materials are the flat world's.
name: dam_break
description: A 10-block dam across a valley with a lake behind it, deleted at 3 s.
